components.note: 扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 挤 is squeezing and pushing in.
齐 (qí) — loose sound hint (jǐ vs qí); same part in 剂 jì and 济 jì.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捡 is picking something up.
佥 (qiān) — loose sound hint (jiǎn); same part in 检 jiǎn, 剑 jiàn and 险 xiǎn.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 划 slice; 割 is cutting, as with a knife or sickle.
害 (hài) — loose sound hint (gē vs hài).
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 蹲 is squatting down on the feet.
尊 (zūn) — close sound: 蹲 dūn. 尊 also sounds out 遵 zūn and 樽 zūn.
氵 (water, 三点水) — marks water and liquids, as in 海 sea, 河 river, 汤 soup; 滴 is a drop of liquid, or to drip.
啇 (dí) — close sound: 滴 dī. 啇 also sounds out 敌 dí and 嫡 dí.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喷 is spraying out of the mouth, then to spray.
贲 (bēn) — close sound: 喷 pēn. 贲 also sounds out 愤 fèn.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 唉 is a sigh or exclamation.
矣 (yǐ) — loose sound hint (āi vs yǐ); same part in 挨 āi and 埃 āi.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 侠 is a chivalrous hero, as in 侠客 knight-errant.
夹 (jiā) — close sound: 侠 xiá. 夹 also sounds out 狭 xiá and 峡 xiá.
土 (earth) — marks soil and ground, as in 地 ground, 城 city wall, 坏 broken; 垒 is piling earth into a wall, as in 堡垒 fortress and 全垒打 home run.
厽 (lěi) — same sound: 垒 lěi. 厽 is three small piled blocks.
石 (stone) — marks stones and minerals, as in 碎 shatter, 破 break, 磨 grind; 碗 is a bowl, first made of fired clay or stone.
宛 (wǎn) — same sound: 碗 wǎn. 宛 also sounds out 腕 wàn and 婉 wǎn.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 蒙 is covering, like grass over something; also méng, Mongolia.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 伸 is a person stretching out.
申 (shēn) — same sound: 伸 shēn. 申 also sounds out 神 shén and 绅 shēn.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 拔 is pulling something out.
犮 (bá) — same sound: 拔 bá. 犮 also sounds out 跋 bá and 魃 bá.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 杆 is a pole or shaft.
干 (gān) — same sound: 杆 gān. 干 also sounds out 肝 gān and 赶 gǎn.
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 枚 was a tree stalk; now it is a measure word for small items like coins and stamps.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 喽 is a particle added to sentence ends.
娄 (lóu) — same sound: 喽 lóu. 娄 also sounds out 楼 lóu and 屡 lǚ.
走 (walk) — marks walking and going, as in 起 rise, 赶 hurry; 趁 is going while the chance lasts, as in 趁热 while hot.
刂 (knife; 刀) — marks cutting, as in 别 separate, 刻 carve, 划 slice; 刮 is scraping, shaving or blowing wind.
舌 (shé) — loose sound hint (guā vs shé).
火 (fire) — marks fire and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 烟 smoke; 煮 is boiling or cooking.
者 (zhě) — close sound: 煮 zhǔ. 者 also sounds out 猪 zhū and 著 zhù.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 拆 is taking apart with the hands.
斥 (chì) — loose sound hint (chāi vs chì).
阝 (city, 右耳旁) — on the right it marks towns and places, as in 都 capital, 邦 nation; 郡 is a county.
君 (jūn) — close sound: 郡 jùn. 君 also sounds out 群 qún.
米 (rice) — marks grain and rice, as in 粥 congee, 糖 sugar; 粘 is sticky, like cooked rice.
占 (zhàn) — close sound: 粘 zhān/nián. 占 also sounds out 站 zhàn and 沾 zhān.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 骂 has two mouths 口口 — loud scolding.
马 (mǎ) — close sound: 骂 mà. 马 also sounds out 妈 mā and 蚂 mǎ.
囗 (enclosure) — marks borders and boundaries, as in 国 country, 园 garden; 圆 is a round enclosed shape.
员 (yuán) — same sound: 圆 yuán. 员 also sounds out 韵 yùn and 陨 yǔn.
辶 (walk, 走之) — marks movement and roads, as in 过 pass, 进 enter, 送 send; 逗 is stopping or luring, then to tease, as in 逗笑.
豆 (dòu) — same sound: 逗 dòu. 豆 also sounds out 痘 dòu and 头 tóu.
火 (fire) — marks fire and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 烟 smoke; 熬 is simmering on a fire, then enduring hardship, as in 熬夜 stay up late.
敖 (áo) — same sound: 熬 áo. 敖 also sounds out 傲 ào and 遨 áo.
疒 (illness) — marks sickness, as in 病 ill, 疼 pain, 痛 ache; 瘦 is thin, with 叟 (elder) as sound.
叟 (sǒu) — loose sound hint (shòu); 叟 also sounds out 搜 sōu and 艘 sōu.
宀 (roof) — marks houses and shelter, as in 家 home, 室 room, 客 guest; 宰 is a person in the house in charge, then to slaughter, as in 宰相 chief minister.
贝 (shell, money) — marks wealth and trade, as in 财 wealth, 贵 expensive; 贼 is the one who steals it.
戎 (róng) — loose sound hint (zéi vs róng); 戎 also means weapon.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 亿 is a person, now only used for a hundred million.
乙 (yǐ) — close sound: 亿 yì.
艹 (grass, 草字头) — marks plants and herbs, as in 花 flower, 草 grass, 菜 vegetable; 萝 is a vine or root vegetable, as in 萝卜 radish.
罗 (luó) — same sound: 萝 luó. 罗 also sounds out 箩 luó and 逻 luó.
舌 (tongue) — marks the tongue, as in 舒 comfortable, 甜 sweet; 舔 is licking.
忝 (tiǎn) — same sound: 舔 tiǎn. 忝 also sounds out 添 tiān.
力 (strength) — 劝 is using effort to encourage someone, as in 劝告 advise; also in 动 move, 努 strive.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 吞 is swallowing, taking in whole.
天 (tiān) — close sound: 吞 tūn. 天 means sky.
足 (foot) — marks feet and walking, as in 跑 run, 跳 jump, 路 road; 踏 is stepping on or treading.
沓 (tà) — close sound: 踏 tà. 沓 also sounds out 蹋 tà.
火 (fire) — marks fire and heat, as in 烧 burn, 灯 lamp, 烟 smoke; 烫 is scalding, as in 烫伤 burn or ironing.
汤 (tāng) — close sound: 烫 tàng. 汤 means hot soup.
亻 (person) — marks people and their roles, as in 你 you, 们 plural, 信 trust; 侧 is the side or lean, as in 侧面.
则 (zé) — close sound: 侧 cè. 则 also sounds out 测 cè and 厕 cè.
钅 (metal; traditional 金) — marks metals, as in 钱 money, 铁 iron, 铜 copper; 钉 is a metal nail.
丁 (dīng) — same sound: 钉 dīng. 丁 also sounds out 盯 dīng and 订 dìng.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 嘻 is a laughing sound, as in 笑嘻嘻.
喜 (xǐ) — close sound: 嘻 xī. 喜 means joy, fitting a giggle.
女 (woman) — marks women and family terms, as in 妈 mom, 姐 sister, 好 good; 妳 is the female you, written with 尔.
尔 (ěr) — loose sound hint (nǐ vs ěr); same part in 你.
矢 (arrow) — arrows were measured for length; 矮 is short, as in 矮个子.
委 (wěi) — close sound: 矮 ǎi. 委 also sounds out 萎 wěi and 诿 wěi.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 吼 is roaring or shouting.
孔 (kǒng) — loose sound hint (hǒu vs kǒng).
木 (tree) — marks trees and wooden things, as in 树 tree, 林 woods, 桌 table; 棵 is the measure word for trees.
果 (guǒ) — close sound: 棵 kē. 果 also sounds out 课 kè and 颗 kē.
口 (mouth) — marks speech, sounds and eating, as in 叫 call, 吃 eat, 唱 sing; 啰 is a particle, as in 啰嗦 long-winded.
罗 (luó) — same sound: 啰 luō. 罗 also sounds out 萝 luó and 箩 luó.
犬 (dog) — a picture of a dog. As 犭 it marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 狼 wolf.
扌 (hand, 提手旁) — marks hand actions, as in 打 hit, 推 push, 拉 pull; 捅 is poking or jabbing.
甬 (yǒng) — close sound: 捅 tǒng. 甬 also sounds out 通 tōng, 勇 yǒng and 桶 tǒng.
犭 (animal; 犬 dog) — marks animals, as in 狗 dog, 猫 cat, 猪 pig; 猛 is fierce like a beast.
孟 (mèng) — close sound: 猛 měng. 孟 also sounds out 锰 měng.
